end.display: by April 2026 (leak repair under way); onset not sourced

intervals.label: liquid-scintillator phase
intervals.note: Year sourced from Wikipedia only. The acrylic-vessel leak repair was under way by April 2026 (LIP slide: "lowering water now to repair"); onset date not sourced.
intervals.quote: In 2022, the detector was filled with Linear alkylbenzene (LAB) liquid scintillator loaded with the wavelength shifter PPO

intervals.label: acrylic vessel leak repair
intervals.note: LIP Advisory Committee slide (27-28 April 2026, J. Maneira): "Acrylic Vessel Repairs: leak in AV, height identified, lowering water now to repair, autumn restart". SNOLAB report of 26 May 2026 has a slide 'SNO+ Cavity Access for Repairs' (rope-access team, boat in the cavity, "No damage to the neck. AV was not stuck", "Installing lights"; photo of the cavity with the water level lowered), so the repair was under way in spring 2026. No source gives the day the scintillator data-taking stopped (the April 2026 reactor analysis, arXiv:2604.05746, uses data "between May 2022 and July 2025", which is an analysis cut, not an end of running), so the start is 'by April 2026' at month precision, approximate. The restart is a plan: 'autumn restart' (autumn 2026 = September-November, middle month 2026-10); the slide does not say what restarts (scintillator data-taking or water fill) and no source dated after 26 May 2026 reports it, so the shutdown is kept at 2026-10-25 and is unconfirmed.
intervals.quote: leak in AV, height identified, lowering water now to repair, autumn restart

start.display: by April 2026 (leak repair under way); onset not sourced

name: SNO+ detector
notes: Modelled as a distinct detector record from detector:sno despite sharing the same physical acrylic vessel/cavern, because the target medium and physics program changed materially (heavy water -> water -> liquid scintillator, eventually tellurium-loaded); see experiment:sno-plus.lineage (`upgrade_of` experiment:sno).

placements.note: Placed at site:snolab-underground-lab, the same cavern as experiment:sno.
placements.quote: The detector underwent a water-filled commissioning phase from 2017 to 2019

summary.plain: The same 12-metre acrylic ball that once held SNO's heavy water, now filled with liquid scintillator, watching for solar neutrinos, reactor antineutrinos, and a hoped-for rare nuclear decay.
summary.technical: SNO's original acrylic vessel and PMT support structure, water-filled 2017-2019 for commissioning, then filled with 780 t of LAB+PPO liquid scintillator from 2022; a future phase will load natural tellurium for a 0νββ search.

technology.note: Structural continuity with the SNO vessel is per the official site's own description of SNO+ as reusing SNO's infrastructure; the specific scintillator mass figure is Wikipedia-sourced only.
technology.value: The original SNO 12 m acrylic vessel and PMT support structure, refilled first with ultrapure water, then with liquid scintillator, and eventually planned to be loaded with tellurium for a double-beta-decay search
